mapper.insert: INSERT INTO task (project_id, title, description, deadline, total_score) VALUES (#{projectId}, #{title}, #{description}, #{deadline}, #{totalScore})
mapper.update: UPDATE task SET project_id = #{projectId}, title = #{title}, description = #{description}, deadline = #{deadline}, total_score = #{totalScore} WHERE id = #{id}
mapper.select: SELECT id, project_id, title, description, deadline, total_score, create_time, update_time FROM task WHERE id = #{id}
